description: One knowledge base: name, recipe (docs / tabular / graph), status, document and chunk counts, embedding model, and ingestion settings. Read it to confirm a KB has content before pointing a flow at it. Get the kbId from workbench_kb_list.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_kb_get
title: Read one knowledge base
